info.name: METT-ElasticSearch
info.description:
Smoke checks against a METT Elasticsearch **release set**.

Physical indexes are `mett-v1-g001-{family}`. Queries use the **release aliases** `mett-v1-{family}` (collection variables `index-*`). Those aliases, plus legacy `*_index` names, currently point at the same v1 generation.

Set `mett-release` (default `v1`) to retarget all `index-*` variables. To hit a concrete generation instead, set an `index-*` variable to `mett-v1-g001-species` (etc.). To hit legacy names, set them to `species_index`.

Auth: `mett-elasticsearch-username` / `mett-elasticsearch-pass`. Host: `{{mett-elasticsearch-current}}`.

Expected totals: fill collection variables (`expected_species_total`, `expected_ppi_total`, …). Leave a count variable empty to assert ≥ 1 only.
